title: Occupancy Extension Surcharge on an Entrance Fee Agreement Cancellation
content:
An **Entrance Fee Agreement** whose planned occupancy date was moved by an occupancy extension carries an extension surcharge added to the processing fee percentage of a cancellation before occupancy: where a signed occupancy extension is on file and the days of notice are fewer than 30, the surcharge is 0.5 percentage points; where a signed occupancy extension is on file and the days of notice are 30 or more, the surcharge is 0.25 percentage points; where no signed occupancy extension is on file there is no surcharge.

The percentage and the surcharge are first added together, and their sum is applied once to the entrance fee of the agreement, the product rounded to the cent half up; this is the gross processing fee.

A signed occupancy extension on file is an occupancy extension request on the agreement's request record with the status signed. The days of notice are the calendar days from the notice date of the cancellation to the planned occupancy date on the agreement.

## Surcharge table

| Signed occupancy extension on file | Days of notice | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Fewer than 30 | 0.5 percentage points |
| Yes | 30 or more | 0.25 percentage points |
| No | Any | None |

## Boundary

| Signed extension on file | Days of notice | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 29 | 0.5 |
| Yes | 30 | 0.25 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Entrance fee 340900.00, a cancellation processing fee percentage of 1.5 percent taken as given for this illustration, a signed extension on file and 45 days of notice: 1.5 and 0.25 added together give 1.75 percent; 340900.00 multiplied by 1.75 percent is 5965.75.

Same agreement with 20 days of notice and a percentage of 2 percent taken as given: 2 and 0.5 give 2.5 percent; the gross processing fee is 8522.50.

An extension request that was never signed is not a signed occupancy extension on file.
